Lion (Panthera leo)||mew.acoustic: High-pitched tonal call with clear harmonics and frequency modulation.
Lion (Panthera leo)||mew.semantic: Close-range contact and care, especially cub-mother and attention-seeking contexts.

Lion (Panthera leo)||puff.acoustic: Soft, short, noisy exhaled sound, often repeated, lacking harsh intensity.
Lion (Panthera leo)||puff.semantic: Low-intensity affiliative greeting and peaceful close-range social contact.

Lion (Panthera leo)||woof.acoustic: Short, abrupt, broadband bark-like call with a low, forceful onset.
Lion (Panthera leo)||woof.semantic: Alert response to nearby threat or disturbance; short-range warning signal.

Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||roar.acoustic: Loud, low-pitched, long sequences of discrete phrases with inflated air sac.
Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||roar.semantic: Long-distance intergroup spacing; also chorused at dawn and toward leopards or eagles.

Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||snort.acoustic: Short, broadband explosive noise with sudden onset, energy below 4 kHz.
Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||snort.semantic: Predator detection and low-level threat warning, often preceding roars.

Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||purr.acoustic: Soft, low-pitched close-range call, audible only at short distance.
Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||purr.semantic: Coordinates group departure and progression during movement.

Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||caw.acoustic: Short, harsh, repeated call grading toward squeaks under higher arousal.
Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||caw.semantic: Mild distress or low-level threat by females, juveniles, and infants.

Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||squea.acoustic: Graded high-pitched, high-amplitude calls from short squeaks to long noisy screams.
Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||squea.semantic: Acute distress and recruitment during agonism, infant handling, or severe disturbance.

Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||tongu.acoustic: Brief, broadband non-vocal transient from tongue against palate.
Mantled guereza (Colobus guereza)||tongu.semantic: Close-range mild aggressive signal in territorial and threat displays.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||close call.acoustic: Quiet, short, individually variable tonal call repeated during foraging.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||close call.semantic: Maintains group cohesion and spatial coordination during foraging.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||moving cal.acoustic: Conspicuous call, given singly or in chorus, distinct from close and lead calls.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||moving cal.semantic: Quorum-like signal coordinating patch shifts and returns to burrows.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||aerial ala.acoustic: Short, loud call; harmonic at low urgency, noisier and abrupt at high urgency.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||aerial ala.semantic: Aerial predator alarm eliciting escape responses scaled by urgency.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||terrestria.acoustic: Loud, short call with urgency-dependent noisiness and temporal patterning.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||terrestria.semantic: Ground-predator alarm triggering vigilance and refuge-seeking behaviour.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||recruitmen.acoustic: Loud, repeated noisy elements with urgency-dependent structure.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||recruitmen.semantic: Recruits group members to inspect or mob localized threats like snakes.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||bark.acoustic: Broadband noisy call lacking harmonics, with multiple formants below 15 kHz.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||bark.semantic: Predator-detection call encoding caller identity and predator context.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||single-not.acoustic: Soft, short single tonal note repeated during sentinel bouts.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||single-not.semantic: All-clear signal reducing forager vigilance at low predation risk.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||double-not.acoustic: Soft, individually distinctive call of two short tonal notes.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||double-not.semantic: All-clear sentinel signal calming foragers at low perceived risk.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||triple-not.acoustic: Short sentinel call of three tonal notes in the graded sequence.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||triple-not.semantic: Encodes subtle rise in perceived risk above the all-clear range.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||multiple-n.acoustic: Cluster of more than three repeated short tonal notes.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||multiple-n.semantic: Signals elevated risk below warning-call threshold during guarding.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||di-drrr se.acoustic: Longer, modulated sentinel warning call distinct from note-counted calls.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||di-drrr se.semantic: Warning signal raising vigilance and reducing foraging at elevated risk.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||wheek sent.acoustic: Long, high, modulated warning call near the high-risk end of the gradation.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||wheek sent.semantic: High-risk warning increasing vigilance before predator-specific alarms.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||repeat beg.acoustic: Repeated pup call given in long bouts while following foraging adults.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||repeat beg.semantic: Mobile pup begging; rate tracks hunger and drives adult provisioning.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||high-pitch.acoustic: High-frequency, intense begging call given in vigorous bouts.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||high-pitch.semantic: Pup solicitation during direct feeding events; preferred by provisioning adults.

Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||sunning ca.acoustic: Soft bouts of one to several short notes given during morning sunning.
Meerkat (Suricata suricatta)||sunning ca.semantic: Turn-taking affiliative call supporting group bonding after burrow emergence.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||basic grunt.acoustic: Low-frequency, harmonically structured short grunt, given singly or in bouts.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||basic grunt.semantic: Affiliative contact during feeding, travel, and close approaches; signals benign intent.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||broken grun.acoustic: Low-volume, rapid series of short, temporally segmented grunt elements.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||broken grun.semantic: Low-intensity agonistic signal during tense encounters that may escalate.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||pant-grunt.acoustic: Louder, pulsed two-phase grunt with inhaled and exhaled components in fast bouts.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||pant-grunt.semantic: Higher-arousal agonistic call during escalated social conflict.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||roargrunt.acoustic: Deep, resonant, sustained low-pitched male call grading toward roar-like sound.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||roargrunt.semantic: Adult male display and threat after fights or disturbances; signals identity and arousal.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||cough-bark.acoustic: Short, abrupt, broadband cough-like bark, harsher than contact calls.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||cough-bark.semantic: Low-anxiety alarm alerting group to unfamiliar humans or aerial disturbance.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||cough-geck.acoustic: Short, sharp, noisy cough-like geck, given singly or in brief series.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||cough-geck.semantic: Low-level alarm and orientation toward possible external disturbance.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||wa-hoo.acoustic: Loud two-syllable call: sharp wa onset followed by lower hoo, repeated in bouts.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||wa-hoo.semantic: Long-distance contact, male display, and alarm during predator or intergroup contexts.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||shrill bark.acoustic: Loud, explosive high-frequency noisy bark with sharp onset.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||shrill bark.semantic: Sudden-threat alarm orienting group toward immediate danger.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||scream.acoustic: Loud, high-pitched, harsh sustained call varying with arousal.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||scream.semantic: Distress signal during pain, fear, or retreat in intense aggressive encounters.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||moan.acoustic: Soft, tonal, frequency-modulated immature call, longer than a geck.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||moan.semantic: Infant distress during separation, weaning, or tantrums; recruits caregiving.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||basic geck.acoustic: Brief, sharp, noisy broadband geck with abrupt onset, singly or repeated.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||basic geck.semantic: Immature distress and contact call during discomfort, fear, or separation.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||panting.acoustic: Breathy, pulsed, repeated pant-like elements; low tonality.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||panting.semantic: Nonaggressive play call during juvenile rough-and-tumble interactions.

Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||copulation.acoustic: Conspicuous female call sequence given during or after copulation.
Olive baboon (Papio anubis)||copulation.semantic: Post-mount female signal implicated in sperm competition and mate choice.

Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||crowing.acoustic: Loud stereotyped male call with 3-4 harmonic note peaks and some harsh energy.
Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||crowing.semantic: Dawn territorial advertisement, dominance signaling, and mate attraction.

Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||courtshi.acoustic: Low-amplitude rapid series of brief kuk-like pulses, deepening during close display.
Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||courtshi.semantic: Male signal near food attracting females, often preceding feeding or mating.

Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||nest-sit.acoustic: Rapid dense train of short low-pitched notes, similar to male food call.
Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||nest-sit.semantic: Male courtship call attracting hens to a potential nest site.

Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||maternal.acoustic: Soft brief single low notes repeated rapidly and irregularly.
Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||maternal.semantic: Broody hen directing chicks to food items during foraging.

Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||clucking.semantic: Broody hen maintaining brood cohesion while leading chicks.

Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||ground-p.acoustic: Harsh broadband cackling series with abrupt cut-like notes and loud terminal elements.
Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||ground-p.semantic: Mobbing/scolding alarm for ground or perched predators, alerting flock.

Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||aerial-p.acoustic: Very loud harsh high-frequency scream with gradual onset.
Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||aerial-p.semantic: High-urgency aerial predator alarm prompting immediate escape or cover.

Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||distress.acoustic: Very loud long harsh broadband squawks with abrupt onset and broken harmonics.
Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||distress.semantic: Adult capture/restraint distress, alerting nearby conspecifics to danger.

Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||threat c.acoustic: Harsh low-frequency broadband call, can grade into roar-like sounds.
Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||threat c.semantic: Close-range aggressive/defensive signal in dominance and contest encounters.

Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||chick di.acoustic: High-pitched repeated descending trills with irregular very-high-frequency elements.
Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||chick di.semantic: Chick separation, capture, or fear call eliciting parental retrieval.

Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||chick pl.acoustic: Soft repeated chevron-like notes with rising average frequency.
Red junglefowl (Gallus gallus)||chick pl.semantic: Chick contact call during feeding, brooding, and secure mother contact.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||coo.acoustic: Clear narrowband tonal call with harmonic structure and low-frequency energy.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||coo.semantic: Contact call for group cohesion, mother-infant reunion, and low-quality food discovery.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||grunt.acoustic: Low, atonal pulsed call with unstable fundamental and strong low-frequency bands.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||grunt.semantic: Close-range contact during grooming and at common or low-quality food sources.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||warble.acoustic: Tonal harmonic food call with modulated frequency contour.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||warble.semantic: Signals discovery of rare high-quality food, recruiting group members.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||harmoni.acoustic: Tonal harmonic call with arch-shaped rising-falling frequency contour.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||harmoni.semantic: High-quality food discovery call recruiting nearby conspecifics.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||chirp.acoustic: Short, brief tonal call distinct from noisier harsh calls.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||chirp.semantic: High-quality food discovery call attracting group members.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||bark.acoustic: Harsh, abrupt broadband call with noisy energy across frequencies.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||bark.semantic: Close-range agonistic threat paired with aggressive facial display.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||pant-th.acoustic: Repeated breathy, weakly voiced harsh pulses, longer and less voiced than grunts.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||pant-th.semantic: Aggressive threat from dominants toward subordinates during agonistic displays.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||girney.acoustic: Soft tonal or warbling call produced in short repeated bouts.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||girney.semantic: Affiliative close-range call with lipsmacking during friendly or appeasing contact.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||noisy s.acoustic: Loud broadband scream with noisy energy and little tonal structure.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||noisy s.semantic: Victim recruitment scream during contact aggression from higher-ranking opponents.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||arched.acoustic: Loud tonal scream with sharply rising-falling arch-shaped frequency contour.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||arched.semantic: Recruitment scream encoding opponent and aggression type in agonistic encounters.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||tonal s.acoustic: Long tonal scream with clear low-frequency contour and narrow bandwidth.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||tonal s.semantic: Recruitment scream in non-contact aggression from higher-ranking opponents.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||pulsed.acoustic: Scream of short pulses ranging from noisy to tonal, less stable than tonal screams.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||pulsed.semantic: Recruitment scream encoding opponent and aggression details in agonistic events.

Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||undulat.acoustic: Long tonal scream with repeated up-down frequency modulation and harmonic bands.
Rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta)||undulat.semantic: Recruitment scream in non-contact rank-difference agonistic encounters.

Ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta)||moan.acoustic: Tonal, harmonic contact call with graded frequency modulation and individual signatures.
Ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta)||moan.semantic: Low-arousal cohesion call maintaining contact during travel, foraging, and spacing.

Ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta)||chirp.acoustic: Brief, high-frequency tonal call produced in repeated bouts.
Ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta)||chirp.semantic: Affiliative contact during group travel and coordinated movement.

Ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta)||wail.acoustic: Loud, high-frequency tonal call with strong frequency modulation.
Ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta)||wail.semantic: Moderate- to high-arousal contact during travel or separation risk.

Ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta)||howl.acoustic: Loud, long-distance male call with tonal harmonic structure and frequency modulation.
Ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta)||howl.semantic: Male advertisement and long-range contact signalling group location and spacing.

Ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta)||yip.acoustic: Short, high-pitched call with abrupt onset and graded intensity.
Ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta)||yip.semantic: Submissive or appeasement signal during close social tension with dominants.

Ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta)||rasp.semantic: Aerial predator alarm eliciting raptor-specific escape behavior.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||whoop.acoustic: Loud, long-distance tonal bouts of upward-sweeping units with individual signatures.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||whoop.semantic: Long-range contact, identity advertisement, and rallying clan support.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||fast wh.acoustic: Rapid, higher-pitched whoop bout with shorter intervals signaling high arousal.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||fast wh.semantic: Recruits allies during high-arousal conflicts over kills or with rivals.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||grunt.acoustic: Soft, low-pitched, rough close-range growling sound lasting several seconds.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||grunt.semantic: Low-level agonistic spacing signal toward approaching unwelcome hyenas.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||groan.acoustic: Low, sustained, tonal ooo-like close-range call, rounder than the grunt.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||groan.semantic: Affiliative greeting and adult-cub caregiving contact at close range.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||low.acoustic: Low-pitched, sustained ooo-like graded arousal call, less bout-structured.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||low.semantic: Shared arousal signal during tense feeding or social conflicts.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||giggle.acoustic: High-pitched staccato bouts of short notes encoding age, status, and identity.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||giggle.semantic: Distress and submission during feeding competition or being attacked.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||yell.acoustic: Loud, sustained high-pitched call, more intense than giggle notes.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||yell.semantic: Acute distress signal while being bitten in close-range aggression.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||growl.acoustic: Loud, low, harsh broadband rattling call lasting several seconds.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||growl.semantic: High-intensity defensive threat before or during retaliatory biting.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||soft gr.acoustic: Rapid, soft, low-pitched staccato grunt series with pulsed structure.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||soft gr.semantic: Surprise fleeing from predators or attacking large prey at close range.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||loud gr.acoustic: Louder, extended bouts of repeated low-pitched grunt-like elements.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||loud gr.semantic: Coordinated group threat during clashes with lions or rival clans.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||whine.acoustic: Loud, high-pitched, drawn-out repeated squealing whine.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||whine.semantic: Cub begging signal of need or frustration when following or denied food.

Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||soft sq.acoustic: Soft, smooth, high-pitched close-range squeal, quieter than the whine.
Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta)||soft sq.semantic: Appeasing reunion greeting between clan mates after separation.

Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||contac.acoustic: Short, low-amplitude broadband pulse with concave frequency contour.
Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||contac.semantic: Within-group spacing signal maintaining acoustic contact during travel and foraging.

Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||gr-gr.acoustic: Rapid series of concatenated contact-like pulses perceived as a broken, pulsed bout.
Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||gr-gr.semantic: Food-associated call recruiting conspecifics to feeding sites.

Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||food-a.acoustic: Series of tonal, frequency-modulated whistles forming a structured bout.
Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||food-a.semantic: Signals food discovery and elicits approach by conspecifics.

Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||long-d.acoustic: Loud, long, tonal whistle series structured to propagate beyond the group.
Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||long-d.semantic: Long-distance coordination, between-group spacing, and reunion with the social group.

Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||bark.acoustic: Short, loud, broadband noisy call with sharp, abrupt structure.
Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||bark.semantic: Functionally referential aerial-predator alarm eliciting antipredator responses.

Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||hiccup.acoustic: Short, abrupt broadband call, often repeated in series during sustained disturbance.
Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||hiccup.semantic: Generalised disturbance/urgency call, often to terrestrial threats.

Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||peep.semantic: Preferentially produced to terrestrial threats; referentiality uncertain.

Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||wah-wa.acoustic: Repetitive harsh broadband pulses (~100 ms each) with energy between 0.9–3 kHz.
Tufted capuchin (Sapajus apella)||wah-wa.semantic: Response to sudden loud low-frequency stimuli such as thunder or explosive noises.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Short, low-intensity grunt-like alarm call.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Alerts group to minor terrestrial threats, prompting inspection rather than escape.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Moderate-intensity, abrupt alarm call of intermediate amplitude.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Given to sudden appearance of minor predators; elicits orientation or flight.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Staccato, broadband call with clusters of short high-frequency elements.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Snake alarm eliciting ground inspection; also used in intergroup aggression.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Rough, low-frequency noisy alarm call with short elements.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Aerial-predator alarm prompting upward looking or cover-seeking.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Short, sharp, loud alarm with long elements at medium frequency.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Terrestrial ambush-predator alarm eliciting tree-climbing escape.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Loud, gruff, repeated long-distance call by adult males.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Male alarm to large predators and signal during intergroup aggression.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Harsh, low-frequency threat-grunt call.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Agonistic threat signal in within- and between-group aggression.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Short ~125 ms aperiodic call, F0 ~240 Hz, with context-specific spectral peaks.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Context-specific social call for approach, movement, and intergroup coordination.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: High-pitched, noisy, high-amplitude call varying with role and severity.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Agonistic distress signal recruiting aid and inhibiting aggression.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Shrill, high-pitched graded defensive call.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Defensive call by females and juveniles inhibiting attack or soliciting aid.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Deep, non-tonal, guttural repeated woof elements.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Submissive display by subordinate males during dominance interactions.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Continuous tonal exhalation paired with grimace.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Submissive display vocalization by subordinate males.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Composite guttural woof followed by tonal wa exhalation.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Submissive display by subordinate males in dominance encounters.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Long, graded aar-like call with mouth slightly open.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Intergroup encounter call recruiting group members to contested areas.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Infant-only multi-syllable wawoo call.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Infant intergroup-encounter call paralleling adult territorial vocalizations.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Rraugh-like call with mouth closed and teeth covered.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Appeasement call by yearlings approaching older group members.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Nonphonated rapid lip and teeth movements audible only at close range.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Close-range appeasement signal during grooming and social approach.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Very quiet, low-frequency close-range purring.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Affiliative play signal by juveniles during play-wrestling.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Loud, attention-getting rrr- and scream-like calls with individual signatures.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Distress call recruiting mothers and helpers during separation or threat.

Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.acoustic: Quiet, short, non-tonal repeated eh-eh call.
Vervet monkey (Chlorocebus pygerythrus)|.semantic: Mother-offspring reunion call supporting close-range affiliative contact.

Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.acoustic: Long downward-sweeping frequency-modulated underwater tonal call.
Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.semantic: Male territorial advertisement and courtship at breeding holes.

Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.acoustic: Short broadband or steeply frequency-modulated underwater call, under one second.
Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.semantic: Close-range underwater contact and location cue during social and courtship encounters.

Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.acoustic: Short low-amplitude underwater call with energy below ~1 kHz.
Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.semantic: Male close-range courtship and affiliative signal toward females.

Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.acoustic: Long, loud, low-frequency broadband underwater call.
Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.semantic: Male advertisement and assessment signal toward rivals and females.

Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.acoustic: Short abrupt high-amplitude broadband underwater pulse, alone or in series.
Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.semantic: Male territorial threat near defended breathing holes.

Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.acoustic: Moderately long underwater call with repeated narrowband mid-kHz elements.
Weddell seal (Leptonychotes weddellii)||.semantic: Male breeding-season underwater display near breathing holes.
